about.title: Our Story
about.html:
OUR HERITAGE

A tradition worth sharing.

Gather around the table.

Pilaf, also known as plov, is a celebrated part of Uzbek culinary heritage. Rice, vegetables and spices come together in a dish associated with hospitality and shared meals.

THE BEST PILAF is developing a ready-to-eat collection for the US market. Our ambition is to make this tradition more accessible without claiming that products are already available.

Explore our collection
